verdict.rationale: The official clickhousectl CLI documents setting up ClickHouse Cloud and creating cloud-managed clusters. ClickHouse Cloud markets starting "instantly without having to size and scale your cluster", with automatic compute scaling up, down and to zero when idle, which covers the no-capacity-planning part of the story. Missing for 10: evidence that provisioning completes in seconds, documented details of API-based provisioning (only a generic openapi.json probe), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the create-and-connect flow.
